dataset.note: Commons uploads, not a prospective street-photo test.

facts: Cosine similarity; best reference photograph per distinct statue.

pool.section: 2. The headline result: accuracy against candidate-pool size
pool.note: Rounded measured means transcribed from the published results table, not new computation. Research vectors, distinct from browser vectors.

location.section: 16. The reviewer checks: what the explanations survive
location.note: Simulated users, held-out weights. The filter penalty is relative to random pools of the same size, not an unconditional comparison to the full pool. Most errors are not within lookalike families.

photographer.section: 9. Is it recognising the statue, or the photographer?; 18. Internal reviews: sensitivity, scarcity and a multi-vector baseline
facts: Withholding the query photographer reduces retrieval accuracy.
photographer.note: Reference scarcity accounts for much of this drop; see section 18. The video does not attribute the whole drop to style.

verification.section: 16. The reviewer checks: what the explanations survive
verification.note: Weights selected on held-out statues. SIFT has no established measurable gain in this comparison; do not generalize to every geometry method or protocol.

uncertainty.section: 16. The reviewer checks: what the explanations survive
uncertainty.note: Research unknown-statue evaluation, not an accuracy guarantee or rejection feature in the browser demo. Illustrative bars have no numeric scores.

facts: Pool size, location and photographer are evaluated separately.
takeaway.note: The browser reports its own shipped-vector measurements. Street photographs remain an unmeasured domain gap.

facts: Each selected photograph retains author, source URL, licence and licence URL.
